changes.title: California bans common pricing algorithms
changes.instrument: AB 325 (Stats. 2025, ch. 338), Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729
changes.summary: From 1 January 2026, using or distributing a common pricing algorithm as part of a price-fixing arrangement is unlawful. Applies to every California address in the portfolio.

changes.title: Hoboken and Jersey City algorithm bans
changes.instrument: Hoboken Code ch. 158; Jersey City Ord. 25-057
changes.summary: Each city's ban applies only inside its own boundary, decided by the geocoded legal city, never the mailing address. Newark has no such ordinance.

changes.title: New Jersey FAIR Act
changes.summary: Statewide ban on algorithmic rent setting from 1 July 2027. It may preempt the Hoboken and Jersey City ordinances; those addresses are flagged for human review.

changes.title: Massachusetts algorithm bills
changes.summary: Pending bills, not law. If enacted they would reach every Massachusetts address in the portfolio.

changes.title: Massachusetts rent control ballot question
changes.summary: Struck from the ballot by the Supreme Judicial Court on 23 June 2026 (Cella v. Attorney General). No rent cap is reported for any Boston or Cambridge address.
